detail.rationale: Admit one explicit directional Governance-to-Ontology-Lifecycle relationship while preserving endpoint autonomy, exact upstream identity, downstream translation, non-authority transfer, and the absence of a reverse edge.
detail.selection_source: Exact user instruction `approved` in the active task, following presentation of the complete CTX04 Context Map.

assignment.scope: Versioned Context Map membership and explicit directional relationship contracts; excludes endpoint context admission and silent derivation of endpoint classifications.

boundary.dependency_semantics: Ontology Lifecycle consumes Governance-owned authority, decision, admission, challenge, and invalidation meanings without acquiring their ownership.

detail.authority_boundary: Governance remains the sole semantic and decision authority for the published outcome. Ontology Lifecycle may record, order, replay, and project evidence of that outcome but cannot create, adopt, amend, revoke, invalidate, reinterpret, or enforce a Governance Decision. The Published Language and downstream Anti-Corruption Layer transfer information, never authority, ownership, admission, or permission.
detail.information_boundary: Governance publishes only an exact immutable owner-decision envelope: decision identity and version, decision kind, subject reference, source digest, authority scope, lifecycle or admission outcome, effective boundary, challenge route, and cited evidence references. Ontology Lifecycle may translate that envelope into its local Governance Event and Exact Semantic Event Reference records while preserving the exact upstream identity and digest. Missing, ambiguous, or unmapped fields become Typed Residue; mutable Governance internals, implicit classifications, credentials, and enforcement capability do not cross.

detail.claim_ceiling: This decision admits only the exact Governance-to-Ontology-Lifecycle Context Map and its one map-local directional relationship pattern. It does not admit a reusable global relationship kind, create a reverse dependency, mutate endpoint artifacts, admit either source ontology, authorize a runtime adapter, migration or implementation, commit, publish, deploy, or establish a stable release.
excluded_effects: No reverse Ontology-Lifecycle-to-Governance edge or feedback contract is selected or admitted.
No reusable global relationship-kind definition or artifact is admitted; the pattern remains local to this exact map relationship.
No endpoint context or Ubiquitous Language bytes are changed, and no context_map_refs are silently inferred.
No source governance ontology or Ontology Lifecycle business ontology receives admission through this map.
No payload schema, Anti-Corruption Layer adapter, transport, capability instance, DomainSpec source, system ontology, or implementation binding is admitted.
No migration planning or execution, destructive action, commit, push, publication, deployment, external effect, or stable release is authorized or performed.
